name: Central Market, Koudougou
features: Market built of compressed earth blocks: rows of arched and vaulted stalls around shaded lanes.
note: Architect and earth-block construction from memory of the Aga Khan citation (Laurent Séchaud with Pierre Jequier); the akdn.org page was unreachable. Commons description says built 2005. Marché central is an overview from above; Grand marché is inside the vaulted lanes.
features_on_wall: Market built of compressed earth blocks: rows of arched and vaulted stalls around shaded lanes.

name: Yaama Mosque
features: Mud-brick hall with a central dome and four tapering corner towers, banded and crowned, built by its own village.
note: No photo on Commons (also searched as 'Yamma'). Sources give: rectangular hypostyle hall begun 1962, central dome and four corner towers added later, towers with banded tapering walls more elaborate toward the pinnacle, parapet of half-circle crenellations. No dimensions are published, so tower and dome heights are proportioned from memory of published photos and may be off; the towers' top ornament is simplified to a ring of small crenellations and a rounded cone.
features_on_wall: Mud-brick hall with a central dome and four tapering corner towers, banded and crowned, built by its own village.

name: Mbaru Niang, Wae Rebo
by: Yori Antar with the Wae Rebo community
features: Tall conical houses of timber and thatch, rebuilt by the villagers with their ancestral techniques.
note: Shortlisted as 'Reconstruction of Mbaru Niang'. Architect credit (Yori Antar, Rumah Asuh) and 2011 completion are from memory; check. It is a vernacular reconstruction, so 'Historic precedent' fits best in the vocabulary.
features_on_wall: Tall conical houses of timber and thatch, rebuilt by the villagers with their ancestral techniques.

name: Royal Academy for Nature Conservation
features: Stone building set into the forested hillside of the Ajloun reserve, entered across a bridge.
note: Only one free photo (4032x3024), a night view of the stone wall and entrance bridge. Year 2014 from memory; check.
features_on_wall: Stone building set into the forested hillside of the Ajloun reserve, entered across a bridge.

name: Bhong Mosque
by: Rais Ghazi Mohammad (patron) with local craftsmen
features: Village mosque built and decorated over fifty years, 1932-82, crowded with domes, minarets and ornament.
note: Wikipedia names no architect; the patron's name is from memory, check. The award was controversial (praised for craft, criticised as kitsch); worth a line if the owner wants it. Many more free photos on Commons.
features_on_wall: Village mosque built and decorated over fifty years, 1932-82, crowded with domes, minarets and ornament.

name: Palais des Expositions (Grand Palais), Charleroi
by: AgwA, architecten jan de vylder inge vinck
features: 1950s exhibition halls opened up and reworked, with a sunken park and open-air seating cut into the site.
note: Completion year not confirmed by a source (CC0 photos from 2024 show it finished); check before publishing. Original 1954 building by Joseph Tirou and Octave Pinkers. Many more CC0 2023-24 photos in the category.
features_on_wall: 1950s exhibition halls opened up and reworked, with a sunken park and open-air seating cut into the site.

name: NAVEZ, 5 social housing units
features: Five social flats in a slim white tower with softened, curved corners that closes the end of a city block.
note: Corner of rue Navez and rue Portaels, Schaerbeek. Completion year from memory (2016); check.
features_on_wall: Five social flats in a slim white tower with softened, curved corners that closes the end of a city block.

name: Katyń Museum
features: Museum in a 19th-century citadel fort; a narrow stair cuts straight through the earth rampart.
note: Parent Category:Katyn Museum in Warsaw also has many interior photos (2023 series). Opening year from memory; check.
features_on_wall: Museum in a 19th-century citadel fort; a narrow stair cuts straight through the earth rampart.

name: Scientific Information Centre and Academic Library (CINiBA)
features: Two interlocking blocks clad in red sandstone, pierced by scattered narrow vertical windows.
note: Cladding material (red sandstone) from memory; check.
features_on_wall: Two interlocking blocks clad in red sandstone, pierced by scattered narrow vertical windows.

name: Hedge House
features: Concrete and glass art pavilion in the garden of Kasteel Wijlre, set low between tall hedges.
note: Completion year from memory; check.
features_on_wall: Concrete and glass art pavilion in the garden of Kasteel Wijlre, set low between tall hedges.

name: Stuttgart Music School (Musikhochschule)
by: James Stirling, Michael Wilford and Associates
features: Drum-shaped tower with ring balconies and porthole windows anchors the school next to Stirling's Staatsgalerie.
note: Year: the Stirling building opened 1996 (prize 1997); the university's Wikipedia intro says its main building was completed 2002, so check the date before publishing.
features_on_wall: Drum-shaped tower with ring balconies and porthole windows anchors the school next to Stirling's Staatsgalerie.

name: Stormen Concert Hall and Library
features: Two pale buildings, concert hall and library, frame a new square on the harbour; the library has a tall finned front.
note: Library photos are in the subcategory Category:Stormen bibliotek (includes interiors). Completion year 2014 from memory (concert hall opened 2014); confirm.
features_on_wall: Two pale buildings, concert hall and library, frame a new square on the harbour; the library has a tall finned front.

name: Arquipélago Contemporary Arts Centre
by: Menos é Mais Arquitectos, João Mendes Ribeiro
features: An 1890s sweet-potato distillery in dark basalt restored and joined by new pale concrete buildings for art.
note: Weak: only two Commons photos found and no category; the usable one shows the old basalt buildings and chimney, not the new concrete wings (the other is a close-up of the name on a wall). Portugal's freedom of panorama is uncertain. Year 2015 from memory.
features_on_wall: An 1890s sweet-potato distillery in dark basalt restored and joined by new pale concrete buildings for art.

name: Toho Gakuen School of Music
features: Soundproof lesson rooms as stacked concrete boxes around a courtyard; gaps between the boxes bring daylight in.
note: Only one good photo of the Nikken Sekkei building (4608x2339). Other files in the category show other Toho buildings (Senkawa campus). Feature line based on award descriptions from memory; check before publishing.
features_on_wall: Soundproof lesson rooms as stacked concrete boxes around a courtyard; gaps between the boxes bring daylight in.

name: Appleby Blue Almshouse
features: Almshouse flats for older people in brick ranges round a planted courtyard, reached by shared timber-lined galleries.
note: Only one Commons photo (4032x3024, street corner, clear); it sits in Category:Southwark Park Road, London. Completion year 2023 from memory; galleries detail from memory, check.
features_on_wall: Almshouse flats for older people in brick ranges round a planted courtyard, reached by shared timber-lined galleries.

name: Weald and Downland Gridshell
features: A three-domed lattice of thin green oak laths bent into a peanut-shell shape over an archive sunk into the chalk slope.
note: Free exterior photos on Commons are all 640px geograph files (e.g. Downland Gridshell - geograph.org.uk - 291120.jpg, Gridshell.jpg); larger free files are interiors (Inside the Gridshell... 7018746, 1600px). Interiors could be extras. Height not sourced, so the profile shows proportion only.
features_on_wall: A three-domed lattice of thin green oak laths bent into a peanut-shell shape over an archive sunk into the chalk slope.

name: Bharat Bhavan
features: Arts centre stepped down a hillside to the Upper Lake as terraces and sunken courts, with an open-air theatre.
note: Inaugurated 13 Feb 1982. Category is mostly performance photos; the three listed show the courts, gate with the small domes, and the lakeside terrace. Wikipedia does not describe the form; 'terraces and sunken courts' is from the photos and the well-published design, check before use.
features_on_wall: Arts centre stepped down a hillside to the Upper Lake as terraces and sunken courts, with an open-air theatre.

name: Makoko Floating School
features: 10 m timber A-frame on about 250 plastic barrels: play deck, louvred classrooms, open workshop on top.
note: No photo of the school on Commons (two Makoko files show a different, land-based school). Sources agree: triangular A-frame 10 m high on a 10 x 10 m base, three levels, about 250-256 recycled barrels. Collapsed in a storm on 7 June 2016 (abandoned three months earlier); NLÉ later built an improved version (MFS II, Venice 2016). Floor heights are proportioned, not sourced.
features_on_wall: 10 m timber A-frame on about 250 plastic barrels: play deck, louvred classrooms, open workshop on top.

name: Grand Théâtre de Rabat
features: Sweeping white shell on the Bou Regreg riverbank, with a muqarnas-faceted 1,821-seat hall and outdoor amphitheatre.
note: Completed 2021, inaugurated Oct 2024, opened to the public April 2026. Morocco has no freedom of panorama, so these Commons files may be deleted later; check before relying on them.
features_on_wall: Sweeping white shell on the Bou Regreg riverbank, with a muqarnas-faceted 1,821-seat hall and outdoor amphitheatre.

name: Nid d'Abeille, Carrières Centrales
features: The patio house stacked five levels high: private open-air patios staggered floor by floor into a honeycomb facade.
note: No photo on Commons. Sources: Écochard's 8 x 8 m grid stacked vertically; galleries lead to private patios on both facades; Centre Pompidou drawing titled 'Nid d'abeille R+4, étages pairs et impairs' (ground + 4, alternating even and odd floors), dated 1953 (Wikipedia gives 1952 for the estate). Bay count, window sizes and the ground floor are not sourced and are simplified; most patios have since been enclosed by residents. The extra is the Dec 1954 L'Architecture d'Aujourd'hui cover (tinted photo of the facade, 1313x1717, PD) - could also serve as a gallery image. Wikipedia credits Candilis, Woods and Josic; Casamémoire credits Bodiansky, Candilis and Woods (ATBAT-Afrique).
features_on_wall: The patio house stacked five levels high: private open-air patios staggered floor by floor into a honeycomb facade.

name: Hôtel El Aurassi
features: Long horizontal hotel slab on stacked podiums along the hillside above Algiers bay, every room facing the sea.
note: Wikipedia's Moretti article captions it 1975 and places his Algerian work from 1969; no dedicated English article. 'Every room facing the sea' comes from the photos (single-loaded slab facing the bay), not a text source - trim if unwanted. Algeria has no freedom of panorama; these files may be challenged later.
features_on_wall: Long horizontal hotel slab on stacked podiums along the hillside above Algiers bay, every room facing the sea.

name: Notre-Dame-de-Lourdes, Casablanca
features: Concrete church with a tall entrance front, vaulted concrete ceiling and walls of Gabriel Loire stained glass.
note: The one clear exterior is an old colour slide of the entrance front (2592x3888). File:Casablanca Notre-Dame-de-Lourde (2).jpg (1280x1920) is unseen. Other CC0 files show the grotto and the vaults inside. Morocco has no freedom of panorama, so check the file survives.
features_on_wall: Concrete church with a tall entrance front, vaulted concrete ceiling and walls of Gabriel Loire stained glass.

name: Rabindra Bhavan
features: Home of three national arts academies: long shaded wings fronted by a canopy of white concrete arches.
note: Wikipedia gives 1961 (or 1963) and says Nehru overruled the initial designs. About 20 free photos. Facade description is from the photos.
features_on_wall: Home of three national arts academies: long shaded wings fronted by a canopy of white concrete arches.

name: Palika Kendra (NDMC Building)
features: 21-storey concrete tower whose base flares out in a great curve, one of Delhi's landmark brutalist buildings.
note: Inaugurated 1984; 21 storeys, 91 m. The flared base is from the photos. Note: File:Civic center.jpg is in the category and shows the same tower.
features_on_wall: 21-storey concrete tower whose base flares out in a great curve, one of Delhi's landmark brutalist buildings.

name: Mortonhall Crematorium
features: Chapels of white flint-aggregate block with tall angled fins and slit windows, set in woodland.
note: Thumbnails not viewable from the sandbox; 'Main chapel' may be an interior, check before use.
features_on_wall: Chapels of white flint-aggregate block with tall angled fins and slit windows, set in woodland.

name: Cultural Center of the Philippines (Tanghalang Pambansa)
features: Locsin's National Theater, opened 1969: flagship of the Cultural Center complex on reclaimed Manila Bay land.
note: The Philippines has no freedom of panorama and Locsin died in 1994, so these could be challenged. Descriptions are generic; check the photos show the main theatre building. Thumbnails not viewable from the sandbox; files chosen from titles, sizes and descriptions.
features_on_wall: Locsin's National Theater, opened 1969: flagship of the Cultural Center complex on reclaimed Manila Bay land.

name: Villa Stein-de Monzie (Les Terrasses)
features: White box of strip windows set out with regulating lines; a canopy marks the door and a balcony the service entrance.
note: No free photo on Commons (France has no freedom of panorama; Le Corbusier died in 1965), only CC0 photos of a V&A model. The Fondation Le Corbusier text (via search) confirms strip windows, the awning over the entrance door and the balcony over the service door; the exact window lengths and door positions are drawn from memory of published elevations, so check against a photo. The garden side with its hanging terrace is not shown.
features_on_wall: White box of strip windows set out with regulating lines; a canopy marks the door and a balcony the service entrance.

name: Conjunto Nacional
features: A whole block on Avenida Paulista: low shopping podium with a roof garden under a 25-storey slab.
note: Not Daniel Libeskind: David Libeskind (1928–2014) was a Brazilian architect. Wikipedia's infobox says 1956 but other sources give 1958–1962; check before publishing the year.
features_on_wall: A whole block on Avenida Paulista: low shopping podium with a roof garden under a 25-storey slab.

name: Covered Plaza, University City of Caracas
features: Shaded plaza of free-form concrete canopies, with murals and sculpture by Léger, Vasarely, Manaure, Arp and Calder.
note: Heart of Villanueva's 'synthesis of the arts'. Aula Magna and both stadiums are already on the wall. The 1955 and 2015 MoMA shows both featured the campus; check the exact building lists if the owner wants the award line precise.
features_on_wall: Shaded plaza of free-form concrete canopies, with murals and sculpture by Léger, Vasarely, Manaure, Arp and Calder.

name: Centro Simón Bolívar (El Silencio Towers)
features: Twin government towers over a long low base, with Avenida Bolívar passing beneath the complex.
note: The thumbnail for the 1965 file showed a framed print on a wall, so it may be a photo of a photo; check before use. Several category files show the newer Plaza Caracas buildings, not the towers.
features_on_wall: Twin government towers over a long low base, with Avenida Bolívar passing beneath the complex.

name: Museo de Bellas Artes de Caracas (1976 building)
features: Villanueva's last work: stacked concrete galleries beside his own 1938 museum in Los Caobos park.
note: Photos show the entrance front only. Dates (1938 first building, 1966–76 second) are from memory and Commons categories; check before publishing.
features_on_wall: Villanueva's last work: stacked concrete galleries beside his own 1938 museum in Los Caobos park.

name: Edificio Panamericano
features: Long apartment slab raised on V-shaped concrete pilotis, facing the river at Buceo.
note: First photo is a close-up of the pilotis; in the second the slab is behind the radio-station pavilion. Year (built 1959–64) from general sources; check.
features_on_wall: Long apartment slab raised on V-shaped concrete pilotis, facing the river at Buceo.

name: Faculty of Architecture, University of the Republic
features: Architecture school built round a central patio and pool, with stone-clad wings and a long glazed front.
note: Year 1946 is the usual completion date; check. Vilamajó's Faculty of Engineering, already on the wall, is nearby.
features_on_wall: Architecture school built round a central patio and pool, with stone-clad wings and a long glazed front.

name: Torres de Tajamar
by: Luis Prieto Vial with Bresciani, Valdés, Castillo, Huidobro
features: Four tall apartment slabs (towers A–D) set in gardens beside Parque Uruguay in Providencia.
note: Wikidata says built 1962–64; the Commons category says 1967. 'Santiago's first high-rise housing' is a loose claim: soften or check. Four towers (A–D) per file names.
features_on_wall: Four tall apartment slabs (towers A–D) set in gardens beside Parque Uruguay in Providencia.

name: Museo de Arte Moderno de Bogotá (MAMBO)
features: Salmona's brick museum: four floors of angled rooms on a central stair, lit by large windows and skylights.
note: Wikipedia says designed 1985 without a completion date; other sources give 1979 for the first phase. Check the year before publishing.
features_on_wall: Salmona's brick museum: four floors of angled rooms on a central stair, lit by large windows and skylights.

name: Petroperú Building
features: Dark office tower rising from a stepped, cantilevered concrete base: the state oil company's brutalist HQ.
note: Weak photos: the first is a grey-sky view (1200×1600); the second is at night among other towers. 'EdificioPetroPeru.jpg' is a better daytime view but only 1152 px wide. Features line is from the photos; check before use.
features_on_wall: Dark office tower rising from a stepped, cantilevered concrete base: the state oil company's brutalist HQ.

name: Biblioteca Luis Ángel Arango
by: Esguerra, Sáenz, Urdaneta, Samper y Cía.
features: Stone-clad public library in La Candelaria, with a projecting upper floor screened by slats.
note: First stage 1958, extended in the 1960s and 70s (concert hall). Dates from general sources; check.
features_on_wall: Stone-clad public library in La Candelaria, with a projecting upper floor screened by slats.

name: Fredensborg Houses
features: Courtyard houses strung along a slope, each with a walled garden, all facing a shared meadow.
note: Built for Danes who had worked long abroad (Wikipedia). Completion year 1963 not in the Wikipedia intro; it is the commonly published date, please double-check.
features_on_wall: Courtyard houses strung along a slope, each with a walled garden, all facing a shared meadow.

name: Opera Village (Operndorf Afrika)
features: Village of school, clinic and houses in local brick and earth, with deep-set windows and shading roofs.
note: Photos are 1633px wide. First two show the school (rendered walls, scattered square windows), the third the houses. Started with Christoph Schlingensief; built in phases from 2010. Wikipedia gives no completion year: 2011 is when the school opened, please double-check.
features_on_wall: Village of school, clinic and houses in local brick and earth, with deep-set windows and shading roofs.

name: Temple Street Parking Garage
features: Long multi-storey car park of stacked concrete decks on arched, tree-like columns spanning over the street.
note: Designed 1961 (Wikipedia, Paul Rudolph article), opened 1963. No article of its own; form described from the photos.
features_on_wall: Long multi-storey car park of stacked concrete decks on arched, tree-like columns spanning over the street.

name: Wurster Hall
by: Joseph Esherick, Vernon DeMars, Donald Olsen
features: Berkeley's architecture school: a raw concrete tower over long wings, its facades hung with deep concrete sunshades.
note: Designed by three faculty members for the College of Environmental Design; renamed Bauer Wurster Hall in 2020. Sunshades described from the photos, not the article.
features_on_wall: Berkeley's architecture school: a raw concrete tower over long wings, its facades hung with deep concrete sunshades.

name: Institute of Hygiene and Microbiology
features: Free-form research and teaching building in raw concrete, with curving wings, outside stairs and a lecture hall wedge.
note: Built 1969-74 for the Free University; listed 2021. Neighbour of the Mäusebunker (already on the wall), across the Teltow Canal. Form words come from the photos.
features_on_wall: Free-form research and teaching building in raw concrete, with curving wings, outside stairs and a lecture hall wedge.

name: Athénée Français
features: French-language school with sculpted concrete walls, painted in pink and deep purple and pierced by small openings.
note: AIJ Prize winner. Colours described from the photos; the archive dates the project 1960-81 (later additions), Wikipedia gives 1962.
features_on_wall: French-language school with sculpted concrete walls, painted in pink and deep purple and pierced by small openings.

name: National Museum of Japanese History
features: Long, low museum on the Sakura Castle ruins, entered across a broad brick forecourt under a vaulted canopy.
note: Building dated 1980 by Ashihara's office; the museum opened 16 March 1983. The features line is drawn from the photos (forecourt and entrance canopy); no source describes the design in detail.
features_on_wall: Long, low museum on the Sakura Castle ruins, entered across a broad brick forecourt under a vaulted canopy.

name: United Nations University Headquarters
features: Symmetrical stepped tower on Aoyama-dori, narrowing like a ziggurat to a pointed glass top, with a front plaza.
note: Handed over by the Japanese government on 30 June 1992; inaugurated 17 February 1993. Wikipedia names Tange but does not describe the form: the features line is from the photos.
features_on_wall: Symmetrical stepped tower on Aoyama-dori, narrowing like a ziggurat to a pointed glass top, with a front plaza.

name: Media-TIC
features: Steel-framed cube wrapped in inflatable ETFE cushions that shade the offices from the sun.
note: No English Wikipedia article; year 2010 is from memory (it won WAF 2011). Fourth photo is a close-up of the ETFE cushions.
features_on_wall: Steel-framed cube wrapped in inflatable ETFE cushions that shade the offices from the sun.

name: Dornbusch Church
features: A 1960s church partly demolished and closed with a new folded wall; the lost part is traced on the plaza.
note: Firm's site gives completion 2005 (Wikipedia: 2004-2006). The traced outline is visible as lines in the paving in the second photo; check wording if unsure.
features_on_wall: A 1960s church partly demolished and closed with a new folded wall; the lost part is traced on the plaza.

name: Unilever-Haus
features: Offices around a tall open atrium, wrapped in a loose ETFE foil skin against the harbour wind.
note: Facts from memory (Behnisch, HafenCity, 2009, ETFE outer skin, central atrium open to the public at ground level). Second photo is a distant view from the Elbe with the Elbphilharmonie.
features_on_wall: Offices around a tall open atrium, wrapped in a loose ETFE foil skin against the harbour wind.

name: Max Aicher Arena
features: Low, flat-arched roof spans the whole speed-skating oval with no inner columns, lit by rooflights.
note: Covered 400 m speed-skating oval. Column-free span and rooflights from memory and the interior photo File:Evo2 Max-Aicher-Arena.jpg (CC BY-SA 4.0), which shows the inside well. Pohl Architekten co-credit from memory; check.
features_on_wall: Low, flat-arched roof spans the whole speed-skating oval with no inner columns, lit by rooflights.

name: Arena Zagreb
features: Oval arena wrapped in a ring of tall, curved white ribs that bend outward at the top.
note: WAF lists it under the Structural Design (Spans) awards; check the year on the WAF page. Third photo shows only one end under a storm sky.
features_on_wall: Oval arena wrapped in a ring of tall, curved white ribs that bend outward at the top.

name: Museum of Memory and Tolerance
features: Heavy stone and concrete volumes on the Alameda, cut by tall glazed openings.
note: Photos are 1200px, donated by the museum. Architect and year from memory (Arditti + RDT, opened 2010); WAF page lists it as a Culture winner without the year clearly shown, check.
features_on_wall: Heavy stone and concrete volumes on the Alameda, cut by tall glazed openings.

name: Hotel Jakarta
features: Timber-framed hotel on the tip of Java Island, built around a glass-roofed subtropical garden.
note: Commons category is named after the address. Interior garden: File:2023 Amsterdam, Hotel Jakarta (02).jpg. Timber structure from memory (timber above a concrete base); check.
features_on_wall: Timber-framed hotel on the tip of Java Island, built around a glass-roofed subtropical garden.

name: Ravenscar House Museum
features: House museum of folded precast-concrete volumes, its rooms laid out like a home around a courtyard.
note: Only one photo (4032x1737), a clear street view. Opened November 2021 (from memory).
features_on_wall: House museum of folded precast-concrete volumes, its rooms laid out like a home around a courtyard.

name: Sony City Osaki (NBF Osaki Building)
features: Office slab whose long face is lined with porous ceramic louvre pipes that cool the air by evaporating rainwater.
note: Only one photo (3648px), a low view of the louvred facade with the Sony sign still on top. Renamed NBF Osaki Building after Sony sold it. 'BioSkin' facade details from memory.
features_on_wall: Office slab whose long face is lined with porous ceramic louvre pipes that cool the air by evaporating rainwater.

name: Belarusian Memorial Chapel
features: Small oak chapel recalling Belarus's wooden churches, with a shingled dome on a slender tower.
note: Church of St Cyril of Turau, North Finchley; memorial to the victims of Chernobyl. Materials from memory and the photos; check 'oak'.
features_on_wall: Small oak chapel recalling Belarus's wooden churches, with a shingled dome on a slender tower.

name: Victoria Gate
features: Department store wrapped in interwoven fins that echo Leeds textiles, beside a glass-roofed arcade.
note: Shopping centre (no retail type in vocab, so Public space). Category has ~60 more photos, mostly 1280px geograph views of the development. Textile reference is from memory; check.
features_on_wall: Department store wrapped in interwoven fins that echo Leeds textiles, beside a glass-roofed arcade.

name: Sara Kulturhus
features: Culture centre and 20-storey hotel tower built in timber, with prefabricated wood modules stacked inside a glass skin.
note: Second photo is at night with the tower lit in colours. Earlier files in the category show construction (useful as extras: exposed timber frame). Hotel is The Wood Hotel; storey count from memory, check.
features_on_wall: Culture centre and 20-storey hotel tower built in timber, with prefabricated wood modules stacked inside a glass skin.

name: Forskaren
features: Round life-science building of stacked floor rings wrapped in slim vertical fins, around a shared atrium.
note: Files are named 'Kvarteret Forskaren, Hagastaden' (no own category found). Some April 2022 files show it under construction; 'Norra tornen och kvarteret Forskaren ... oktober 2022' files show it finished from further away. Atrium detail is from memory; check.
features_on_wall: Round life-science building of stacked floor rings wrapped in slim vertical fins, around a shared atrium.

name: Paula Fox Melanoma and Cancer Centre
features: Two rounded glass towers that pull apart at the top, rising from a sweeping white entrance canopy.
note: Only one photo (3024px square, public domain), a clear street view. At Alfred Hospital, Prahran; year from memory (opened 2023), check.
features_on_wall: Two rounded glass towers that pull apart at the top, rising from a sweeping white entrance canopy.

name: Alila Villas Uluwatu
features: Clifftop resort of low terraced villas and open lattice pavilions, built with local stone and reclaimed timber.
note: Flickr photos with generic titles (Pavilion, Paradise, Dusk) but in the building's own category. Materials from memory (volcanic stone, reclaimed ironwood); check.
features_on_wall: Clifftop resort of low terraced villas and open lattice pavilions, built with local stone and reclaimed timber.

name: Shanghai Suhe MixC World
features: Shopping centre split by a sunken park valley; curving planted terraces step down to the shops.
note: Only one photo (6559px): the sunken valley and green terraces, with a large pink elephant sculpture in the foreground. Opening year from memory (2021), check. No retail type in vocab, so Public space.
features_on_wall: Shopping centre split by a sunken park valley; curving planted terraces step down to the shops.

name: Dalarna Media Library
features: University library wrapped in a deep lattice of horizontal slats that filters daylight into the reading rooms.
note: Dalarna University's library in Falun, both photos in snow. The second file's embedded metadata says 'Todos os dereitos reservados' (all rights reserved) although Commons lists CC BY-SA 4.0 - check its file page before using it. Year and slat material from memory; check.
features_on_wall: University library wrapped in a deep lattice of horizontal slats that filters daylight into the reading rooms.
